searchText: <@808969530608451584> related to this issue, are you planning to support execution payments at all? there is no reason to actually even pay the proposer for the sake of testing and bid selection doesn't really matter hmm, I'm not sure tbh. I can easily return a non 0 value to execution_payment, but I can'T inject an actual payment on the EL side, as buildoor uses a usual EL node without any private mempool or forced tx inclusion for the issue, yea, confirmed. I'll gonna weaken the the check on the builder preferences api. It'S a testing tool, I see no reason to be strict about the URL if not enforced via the `--builder-api-url` flag
